contract_format: closed canonical JSON instance; its validating JSON Schema is frozen in P1 before executable implementation

domain.validity: every listed quotient tuple and every listed integer delivery translation is in-domain; no rejection sampling and no post-hoc valid predicate are permitted
domain.official_delivery_render: let centered(q) be the baseline raster at absolute translation (384,384); rawRender(q,t)=integer_shift(centered(q),t,fill=255) with no wraparound
domain.translation_reduction: the full Draw contract is discharged by centered foreground border >=33 pixels plus the proved byte-level theorem tight_crop_recenter(integer_shift(x,t))=tight_crop_recenter(x) for abs(t.x),abs(t.y)<=32
domain.failure_policy: any empty foreground, clipping, rasterizer exception, semantic construction failure, or translation-contract failure is whole-version NO-GO

motif_rules.binding: build_motif geometry from the source_baseline, replacing random draws by half_length and motif_ordinal as specified
motif_rules.interpretation_function: each quotient tuple q deterministically yields the complete finite ordered interpretation set I(q) from the source_baseline motif rule; semantic scenes are dependent pairs (q,i) with i in I(q)
motif_rules.rounding: signed rational ties-to-even in Q16.16 exactly as source_baseline

graph.chemical_label: nonempty ASCII string; current domain emits only C and TEXT_STROKE
graph.equivalence: bijection on vertices preserving chemical_label, formal_charge, unordered adjacency, and edge_order
graph.canonical_bytes: lexicographically smallest canonical-JSON byte string over every vertex renumbering; object has nodes=[[chemical_label,formal_charge],...] and edges=[[min_index,max_index,order],...] with edges lexicographically sorted; UTF-8 ASCII escaping, sorted object keys, separators comma/colon, no trailing newline

raster.clipping_certificate: render identical absolute geometry on a 1024x1024 Gray8 canvas with the original 768x768 canvas embedded at offset (128,128); all padded foreground must lie inside that embedded rectangle and the embedded rectangle must have at least one all-white border pixel on every side
raster.canonical_equality: length and all 589824 Gray8 bytes equal
raster.storage_png: v0.4 canonical Gray8 PNG encoder; storage only and not class identity
raster.runtime_path: PNG bytes -> strict canonical decoder -> Gray8 -> this preprocessor -> exactly 589824 Gray8 stdin bytes -> extractor
raster.canonical_embedding: embed copies the 589824 CanonicalGray8 bytes into RawGray8 without metadata; P(embed(c))=Success(c) for every canonical c

roots.stream_root: SHA256(concatenation of framed records in canonical full-byte key order)
roots.raster_class_id: ordinal after lexicographic ordering by complete canonical Gray8 bytes
roots.evidence_class_id: ordinal after lexicographic ordering by complete canonical Evidence bytes
roots.graph_class_id: ordinal after lexicographic ordering by complete canonical graph bytes
roots.record_bytes: canonical JSON conforming to the named closed schema frozen in P1; UTF-8, ensure_ascii=true, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, no float, exactly one trailing newline
roots.third_verifier_witness: all published collision witnesses and axis extrema, plus tuple_id when uint256be(SHA256(frame_bytes(raw32(raster_root_hex))||u64be(tuple_id))) mod 10000 == 0

pilot.required_axis_coverage: every value of every declared axis must occur at least once or P1 is NO-GO
pilot.worker_definition: 16 fixed OS processes pinned one per physical core; pilot and full projection use the same worker count
pilot.wall_time_definition: CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed seconds from first worker start through final fsync and root write
pilot.rss_definition: peak aggregate resident bytes for the entire cgroup/process tree, not per process
pilot.temporary_definition: maximum allocated bytes under the dedicated work filesystem from a zero-byte work directory, including external-sort runs
pilot.evidence_selection: after Raster closure select RasterClasses whose minimum member tuple_id satisfies tuple_id mod 100 == 0
pilot.failure_policy: NO-GO without reducing or sampling the declared domain

pack.provenance_tie_break: choose the EvidenceClass member RasterClass with lexicographically smallest full bytes, then its minimum tuple_id; style transform and taxonomy strata use that tuple
pack.delivered_raster_member: the RasterClass member with lexicographically smallest complete canonical Gray8 bytes
pack.delivered_tuple_witness: the minimum tuple_id member of delivered_raster_member
pack.class_seed_rank: uint256be(HMAC-SHA256(pack_seed,frame_bytes(ascii(chemgraph-v0.5/class-rank))||frame_bytes(complete_canonical_evidence_bytes))) ascending, tie by complete Evidence bytes
pack.translation_prng: HMAC-SHA256 counter bytes with key=pack_seed and message=frame_bytes(ascii(chemgraph-v0.5/delivery-translation))||u64be(delivery_ordinal)||u64be(counter), with zero-based delivery_ordinal and counter; consume bytes in order, reject byte>=195, map first two accepted bytes as x=(byte mod 65)-32 and y=(byte mod 65)-32
pack.delivery_order: ascending class_seed_rank after the lexicographically smallest feasible quota assignment
pack.delivery_id: lowercase hex of first 16 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(pack_seed,frame_bytes(ascii(chemgraph-v0.5/delivery-id))||u64be(zero_based_delivery_ordinal)); any collision is NO-GO
pack.selection: jointly choose disjoint U and X assignments satisfying every per-pack quota; among feasible pairs minimize the concatenation of sorted U class_seed_rank values followed by sorted X class_seed_rank values, then tie by complete Evidence bytes; infeasible means NO-GO

commitment.hex_encoding: all SHA256/root strings are lowercase 64-char hex externally and are decoded to raw 32 bytes before crypto framing; Git SHA-1 is lowercase 40-char hex and decoded to raw 20 bytes
commitment.integer_encoding: all uint256 interpretations and fixed-width integers are unsigned big-endian
